home_court.rule: h = sd(home margin) x Phi^-1(measured home win rate)
home_court.note: HCA is pinned, not fitted: with this h and this sd the model's home-win probability for two otherwise equal clubs equals the measured home-win rate exactly. It is a restatement of an official count, not an estimated edge.

rho.definition: r(home margin, total points) over official finals, neutral-site games excluded
